verdict.rationale: Viam docs explicitly describe on-robot data capture with local queuing during outages/low-bandwidth and automatic sync when connectivity returns, plus cloud query/export via SQL/MQL and CLI tools, and community evidence corroborates offline resilience (config caching, operation without internet). Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of configurable bandwidth-throttling/rate-limit policies beyond queue-and-sync, and no independent benchmark of sync behavior under constrained bandwidth.
